claims.implementation: The full durable feature set MS Durable Runtime lists, all under backend/arkali/execution/durable/. Persistent state and checkpoints: records.py + job_store.py, checkpoints immutable by ORM refusal with (job_id, sequence) as identity. Heartbeat and ownership: execution.py, heartbeat_at recorded per attempt, stale owners refused. Idempotency: the persisted uq_durable_job_idempotency constraint, not a cache. Bounded retries: count(job_execution_attempt) against a max_attempts recorded on the job, so the bound cannot be reset by a restart or set by a caller. Timeout: an absolute deadline_at computed once. Cancel: execution.py cancel(), reachable only from RUNNING by the canonical relation. Pause/resume: recovery.py, RUNNING -> PAUSED -> RESUMING -> RUNNING. Crash recovery: recovery.py recover_lost_executions(), RUNNING -> FAILED -> RECOVERABLE -> RESUMING on heartbeat expiry, keyed on a persisted heartbeat_timeout_seconds. Dead-letter: the disposition when the recorded bound leaves no attempt; DEAD_LETTER has no outgoing transition. Approvals/signals are NOT implemented and are not claimed.
